summary: The document contains a VBScript file for managing the screen state and behavior of a SupervisorPRHistory page.
purpose: To define server-side logic for the SupervisorPRHistory page, including response buffering and expiration settings.

workflows.name: Page Initialization
steps: Set the scripting language to VBScript.
Set the HTTP response to expire immediately.
Define the screen name variable strScreenName as 'SupervisorPRHistory'.
Include additional server-side logic from DoScreen.asp.

system_behavior: The page uses response buffering to control the output stream to the client.
The page is set to always retrieve the most recent data by expiring cached responses immediately.
The page includes additional logic from an external ASP file.
dependencies: Depends on additional functionality from the included DoScreen.asp file.
